title: Doozy Vape Co Infinity Strawberry Watermelon Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Strawberry Watermelon by Doozy Infinity brings together two summer staples in a juicy, sweet-tasting blend. Ripe Strawberry leads the way with its bright, jammy flavour, while Watermelon adds a gentle sweetness and lush, refreshing lift. The combination delivers a fruit vape that’s clean, rounded and irresistibly smooth, making it a great choice for an easy, all-day vape. Designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, this Nicotine Salt e-liquid is blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio and performs best in pod kits , vape pens and low-powered refillable vapes . The nic salt formula ensures faster absorption and a more comfortable throat hit, especially at higher strengths. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths, Doozy Infinity Nic Salts are ideal for vapers looking for clear, well-crafted fruit blends with reliable satisfaction in every bottle.
